summary: Space Fractions is a web-based fraction-learning game for sixth graders. The original design specifies a microservices architecture (GameComponent, QuestionComponent, UserComponent) with Express/PostgreSQL and an OAuth2 security posture; the operator supplement layers a concrete acceptance contract (Node.js 22+, Keycloak OIDC PKCE, exact rational arithmetic, owner authorization, pause/resume, scoring, question CRUD) plus Redis/RabbitMQ/Elasticsearch/Prometheus integrations and a gateway on port 3000. This plan implements separate service entrypoints behind one gateway process, PostgreSQL as system of record, and reference-only cloud/K8s/Vault/Istio configs. Contradiction C1 (error budget math) is documented; Node.js 22 and PG16 supersede the original versions per the supplement.

tasks.description: Project scaffold: package.json (pinned deps, scripts test/build/start/test:integration), .env.example, .gitignore, README.md, plan.json, traceability.json, architecture-decisions.md (this file). Establishes the module boundary and script contracts.

contracts.description: Root package.json must expose scripts test, build, start, test:integration with pinned dependency versions; build must actually check source.

tasks.description: Shared domain library: fraction rational arithmetic (reduce via gcd, validate single reduced fraction), game state machine (Playing/Paused/GameOver), and core types. No external I/O.

contracts.description: Exact rational arithmetic: equality via reduced numerator/denominator; malformed fraction returns a typed validation error.
Game lifecycle states Playing/Paused/GameOver with pause/resume/gameOver transitions only.

tasks.description: Persistence layer: SQL migrations (games with game_state JSONB seed + expanded questions/answers/users tables) and idempotent seed data. Every seed answer is a valid single reduced fraction. Honors original games DDL and PG16 constraints (no EXCLUDED in RETURNING).

contracts.description: games table: id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, game_state JSONB NOT NULL (verbatim from original).
Score updates serialize per game and deduplicate in the same transaction; no EXCLUDED in RETURNING; subject->numeric user id upsert; one owned transaction client with rollback on error.

tasks.description: Auth module: OIDC issuer/audience/JWKS validation, admin role extraction, and subject->user id mapping. Uses a provider-agnostic verifier interface so unit tests can inject a fake.

contracts.description: Backend validates issuer/audience/JWKS (http://keycloak:8080/realms/space-fractions/protocol/openid-connect/certs); admin role from realm_access.roles; missing/invalid token -> 401.

tasks.description: Question service module: question CRUD/storage, stable ordering, no correctAnswer in player responses, search via Elasticsearch client with bounded timeout.

contracts.description: Never include correctAnswer in a player-facing response.

tasks.description: Game service module: create game (optional questionIds), play lifecycle (pause/resume), answer submission with scoring/dedup/pause guard, score view, owner authorization. Emits RabbitMQ score events; Redis read-through cache.

contracts.description: POST /api/games {questionIds?} -> 201 {id,questions:[{id,prompt,options}]}; GET /api/games/:id -> state (no correctAnswer); POST pause/resume; POST answers {questionId,answer} -> {correct,score}; repeat answer no score increase; paused answer -> 409; malformed fraction -> 400; other user's game -> 403/404.

tasks.description: Gateway/HTTP entrypoints: Express app wiring game/question/user/admin service modules, /health, static browser UI at /, original GET /play compatibility, admin role middleware, metrics endpoint. One process, multiple service entrypoint modules.

contracts.description: GET /health -> 200; UI at /; authenticated endpoints use Bearer OIDC tokens; original GET /play returns gameId for backward compatibility.

tasks.description: OpenAPI specification and internal.proto: full REST contract (including GET /play compatibility and all /api endpoints) + GameService.Play proto contract.

contracts.description: openapi.yaml documents the gateway contract incl. GET /play; internal.proto declares GameService.Play(PlayRequest)->PlayResponse.

tasks.description: Unit tests (node:test, in-memory/fake adapters, no live infra): scoring, pause/resume, authorization (403/401), invalid input (400 malformed fraction), dedup, error behavior.

contracts.description: Tests must assert scoring, pause/resume, authorization, invalid input, and error behavior without requiring live infra.

tasks.description: Integration tests (separate, gated behind live infra): real HTTP against Compose stack including Keycloak token fixtures, PG transaction behavior, and admin CRUD.

contracts.description: Integration tests run against running infrastructure and must not run as part of default npm test.

tasks.description: Compose + Dockerfiles: services gateway, game-service, question-service, user-service, admin-service, postgres, redis, rabbitmq, elasticsearch, keycloak, prometheus; Keycloak 24.0.5 with PKCE S256 client, demo users, directAccessGrantsEnabled (local-only); bind-mounted realm import; healthchecks.

contracts.description: Compose service IDs exactly: gateway, game-service, question-service, user-service, admin-service, postgres, redis, rabbitmq, elasticsearch, keycloak, prometheus; gateway 3000, keycloak 8080; PUBLIC_ORIGIN/OIDC_ISSUER drive redirects.

tasks.description: Reference-only infrastructure (NOT production-validated, labeled): Kubernetes manifests, Jenkinsfile, AWS Terraform example, Vault and Istio reference config.

contracts.description: Kubernetes Deployment replicas=3 containerPort 80 per original; reference-only configs labeled and not claimed validated.

tasks.description: Build script (actual syntax/consistency check of sources, OpenAPI/proto validation, no echo placeholder) plus traceability.json populated from T1 with implemented/partial statuses and test links.

contracts.description: Build script performs a real check (e.g., node --check across sources, JSON/YAML presence validation).

assumptions: A-1: OIDC subject mapped to numeric user id via idempotent upsert (table schema assumed).
A-2: Answers normalized to single reduced fraction; equality via reduced numerator/denominator.
A-3: Stable question order via deterministic sort key.
A-4: Empty/no questionIds draws from seeded question bank.
A-5: admin role = realm role 'admin' in realm_access.roles.
A-6: Redis/RabbitMQ/Elasticsearch/Prometheus degrade gracefully when absent (log + pass-through).
A-7: GET /play returns gameId (integer) and default question set.
conflicts: C1: 99.99% uptime vs 1% error budget (Architecture_Documentation.md line 181); resolved to 0.01%.
C2: Node.js 18-20 (original) vs Node.js 22+ (supplement); supplement wins.
C3: single JSONB games table (original) vs full question/answer/user schema (supplement); expanded schema, seed DDL preserved.
C4: microservices (original) vs separate entrypoints + one gateway (supplement); separate modules behind one gateway process.
